newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Bulog says rice procurement below target.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Bulog says rice procurement below target.

text.p: Indonesia's logistics bureau (Bulog) chief Beddu Amang said on Thursday the organisation's rice procurement in fiscal 1996/97 (April/March) will be around 1.4 million tonnes, down from forecasts of two million tonnes.

"The realisation of rice procurement in April-September is 1.08 million tonnes. It seem we will find it difficult to achieve two million tonnes of rice procurement in fiscal 1996/97," Amang told parliament.
"The actual rice procurement in 1996/97 is estimated at 1.4 million tonnes," he added.
He said the reason for the fall in procurement was that prevailing prices were above Bulog's offers.
Amang however added that no plans had yet been made for imports because domestic procurement was still in progress.
Last month, Amang was reported to have sought 200,000 tonnes of Thai rice on countertrade terms.
Thai deputy agriculture minister Ammuay Yodshuk said Amang had offered to buy various grades of Thai rice in exchange for two Indonesia-made-CN-235 planes.
